title: Moss and the Wobbly Cane
note: b412 — wordless Phase 1 book (non-fiction: garden canes really do support a leaning plant).

pages.brief: A tall green bean plant leaning sideways in a vegetable patch, Moss the berry-coloured hedgehog noticing beside it.
Moss the hedgehog leaning a single brown garden cane against the leaning bean plant, the cane starting to slip.
Moss the hedgehog scratching his head and looking puzzled at a fallen brown cane on the ground beside the still-leaning plant.
Moss the hedgehog tying two brown garden canes together in a crossed X shape with a loop of green garden twine beside the bean plant.
A green bean plant standing upright, held firmly by two crossed brown canes, Moss the hedgehog checking it.
Moss the hedgehog standing back proudly in the vegetable patch, the bean plant now growing straight and tall among other healthy plants.
